lantern.definition: A light you can carry in your hand. It goes wherever you go.
lantern.example: Grandmother Owl gave Pip a tiny lantern.

mind_criterion.definition: The test that says whether something is good enough, or true enough.
mind_criterion.example: The criterion for a useful fault report is not the length of it but the reason in it.

out_of_office.definition: The automatic reply sent while you are away, telling people when you will return and who to contact instead.
out_of_office.example: You will get an out of office message until 20 April.

rocket.definition: A machine that pushes itself up into the sky with fire and gas. It is how people reach space.
rocket.example: The rocket stood on the pad, white and tall.

truth.definition: What really happened, even when it is not the easy thing to say.
truth.example: An told his mother the truth about the blue bowl.
